sources_considered.why: Read in full. The abstract reports interaction and collaboration evaluations, not representative initial credibility judgments paired with accuracy checks.
Read relevant user-evaluation passages. The reported comparisons do not establish near-universal mistaken acceptance of OpenAI Deep Research reports.
Read participant-method passages. Experts were assigned to verify claims; that does not measure ordinary readers' unprompted initial acceptance.

The evidence located does not estimate whether nearly all reports appear legitimate or how often readers initially accept erroneous ones.
